mmu[?]IV. Gaudium Dei est summa voluptas quâ ipse, in se, tanquam in summo bono omnique suo ibuti[?]statu tanquam beatissimo perfectissimè acqui-escit.

main_text.head: CAP. XII. De Consideratione essentiæ divinæ relata & in specie de ejus unitate.
main_text.p: attri[?]s, qui[?]lbgen[?]HActenus consideravimus Deum absolu-te, sequitur ut eum consideremus rela-te.

ori[?]Hîc notandum quòd ut relata fundantur in absolutis, sic etiam cognitio Dei relata funrioo[?]le-tur in cognitione ejus absoluta, ideoque quæ superius sunt demonstrata, repetenda sunt, ac inter se conferenda, nam ex illorum combina-tione oriuntur sequentia principia.
{y} Cf. note in the printed margin; text not legible.[?]

page.notes: Left margin: the notes are cut off at the scan edge and show only fragments (Vina, mmu, ibuti, ipfi, Ontin, omni, hin, fefti, ter eft, attri, s, qui, lbgen, ori, rioo, nave, erri, fum, feo, prin, mus, inis). They are placed beside the nearest lines, so their positions are approximate. Only the fragments are legible; the rest is outside the scan. The margin fragments beside the heading are attached to the following paragraph. "funle-tur" is probably a printing error for "fundetur" (letters l/d confused); left as printed with [?]. "fundetur" uncertain; "sunt" in "repetenda sunt" uncertain (long s). Greek "ἢ" uncertain. "consideravimus" and "consideremus" read from long-s forms.
